## Problem

What are you trying to do, and where does TEA fall short?
Include a concrete example.

## Proposed change

Describe the behavior you want and the workflow, tool, or documentation it affects.
Include implementation ideas if you have them.

## Alternatives

What have you tried, and why does it fall short?

## Priority

Does this block your work, or would it improve an existing process?
Describe the impact.

## Additional context

Link related issues, examples, or references.
If you plan to contribute, say so and read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/bmad-code-org/bmad-method-test-architecture-enterprise/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
